# loci

> A local, MCP-first second brain: it indexes notes and docs for hybrid search and cited Q&A, so AI coding tools can share one memory. MCP is the primary interface; the terminal, web console and desktop shell are alternate front-ends to the same local index.

Requires Python 3.11+ (`pip install loci-rag`); `loci demo` is a zero-config, keyword-only tour, and `config.toml` selects the embedding/chat providers for hybrid search. `loci-mcp` speaks MCP over stdio; the Python console listens at `http://127.0.0.1:8765/ui` (the native Rust GUI uses 8790). All MCP clients should point at the same `LOCI_HOME` instance to share config, index, memories and state. Files and the index stay on the machine; the native build stores everything in one SQLite file and needs no Python runtime.

## Docs

- [README (English)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/README.md): Quick start, MCP setup, tool table, memory boundaries and the web console.
- [README — 简体中文](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/README.zh-CN.md), [繁體中文](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/README.zh-TW.md), [日本語](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/README.ja.md), [한국어](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/README.ko.md): Translated quick starts and MCP setup.
- [Usage guide (EN)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/guide.en.md): Model providers, hybrid retrieval, reranking, PDF/Word/HTML/org/chat-log loaders, MCP hosts, harness memory hub, console and offline Ollama.
- [使用指南（中文）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/guide.zh-CN.md): Chinese usage guide.
- [Connect an Obsidian vault (Python build)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/obsidian.en.md): Selective scanning, config editing, API key handling, ingest hardening.
- [将 Obsidian 笔记接入 loci（Python 版）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/obsidian.zh-CN.md): Chinese Obsidian guide.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Ingest/query data flow into ChromaDB, module map, identity and chunk-ID invariants, recipes for loaders, retrieval and MCP tools.
- [loci (native)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/native/README.md): Rust build — SQLite index, CLI, MCP server, console and Tauri shell; lists what is ported and what is still Python-only.
- [Configuration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/config.example.toml): Annotated `config.toml` covering LLM/embed providers, sources, HTTP, chunking, retrieval, BM25 tokenizers, harness and store.
- [Roadmap](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/docs/roadmap.md): Shipped features by release and planned work.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/CHANGELOG.md): Release history, including knowledge graph, OCR, exact-key state, memory health, identifier matching, cross-file verification and decision history.
- [Contributing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/IvenKooLab/loci/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): Development setup, dependency ground rules, tests and commit style.
